Government Sells LIC Stake, Raises Over Rs 31,000 Crore

The Indian government has raised over Rs 31,500 crore by selling a 6.5% stake in the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) through an Offer for Sale (OFS). This sale has increased the public holding in LIC to 10%. Reports indicate insurance stocks saw a jump following the sale, attracting investors. However, some coverage noted a dip in LIC's share price, with one outlet mentioning an 8% drop and an OFS discount for retail investors.
